name: TrustRadius

sources.title: TrustRadius 'Claim Your Profile' — Free vs Premium profile comparison, 'Claim my free profile' CTA
TrustRadius for Vendors — vendor portal, review generation, intent data products

requirements: A B2B software/tech product — TrustRadius is an in-depth B2B review platform (reviews are 400+ words)
The product may already have a profile generated from reviewer activity — claim it rather than creating a duplicate
Free profile: presence in front of '1M+ buyers'; Premium adds intent data, custom questions, content syndication, lead forms
preparation: Product profile assets: description, videos/demos, features and integrations, pricing info, security info (items the claim page lists)
Customer list for review-generation outreach — the profile is populated by genuine long-form customer reviews
workflow: Search trustradius.com for the product to see if a profile already exists
Go to solutions.trustradius.com/claim-your-profile/ and choose 'Claim My Free Profile'
Complete the profile (features, integrations, pricing, security info)
Run review-generation campaigns to build 400+ word customer reviews
Verify the public product page is live on trustradius.com
watchFor: The demo funnel aggressively pushes 'Book a demo'/Premium — the Free profile is the zero-cost path and is explicitly offered
Reviews are long-form (400+ words) and moderated — expect a slower review-accumulation curve than G2/Capterra
TrustRadius was acquired by/merged with HG Insights — product branding may shift
A 'Trusted Sellers' verification program exists for vendors following review-generation best practices — a credibility badge worth pursuing after claiming
countsAsLive: A public product profile page on trustradius.com showing claimed status and accumulating verified customer reviews
unknowns: Free profile feature limits vs Premium (intent data, lead capture, TrustQuotes syndication are Premium)
Whether the claimed profile's website CTA link is dofollow on the free tier
